story.title: Story 6: Startup Validation and Assignment Config

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on SV-001 through SV-005 after quick-fix/011, directly touched Story 6 code/tests, focused Story 6 tests, and configured story/epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The literal `unconfigured` placeholder is gone and defaults are now validated, but the shipped default is now `deterministic/default` in `defaultAssignments`. The production SDK path still uses `createModelCall(ctx)`, which resolves assignments through PI `ctx.modelRegistry.find(provider, model)`, not LHC's deterministic provider. No evidence shows `deterministic/default` is a real PI registry lane for the extension user, so AC-5.4's shipped defaults-function requirement remains unproven and appears to rely on a local verification lane.

packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/assignments.ts now rejects unknown keys before merging, and direct proof showed `loadAssignments({made_up_kind:{...}})` throws `Unknown assignment key 'made_up_kind'`. The assignments test also covers this path.

The report now stores a formatted `message` in `SessionState.health`, but `report()` still only calls `ctx.ui.notify` when `ctx.hasUI` is true and has no headless log/output branch. The headless test asserts state text and no UI notify, not an emitted headless channel.

packages/pi-lhc/test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts now captures messages, drains the scheduler, and asserts failed `smoothed_prompt` plus queryable `inspect.health` failure details for the affected lane. Focused tests passed.
`pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify` and `pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify-all` both passed with 20 test files and 140 tests.

openFindings.title: Shipped defaults still are not proven production-reachable PI lanes
openFindings.evidence: packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts:152-154 now defaults all assignments to `{ provider: "deterministic", id: "default" }`; direct proof returned `{provider:"deterministic",model:"default",prompt:"smoothing-v1"}` for `loadAssignments(undefined).smoothed_prompt`. But packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts still builds production inference with `call: createModelCall(ctx)` and those assignments, and packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts:99-109 resolves every assignment through `ctx.modelRegistry.find(provider, model)`. No code path activates LHC's deterministic provider for these defaults, and no artifact proves PI's production registry contains `deterministic/default`.

openFindings.title: Headless unreachable-lane reporting still has no emitted headless channel
openFindings.evidence: packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/startup-validation.ts:91-118 marks the flag and stores the formatted message in `state.health.startupValidation`, but only emits via `ctx.ui.notify` under `if (ctx.hasUI)`. There is no `else` branch or injected output/log channel for headless mode. packages/pi-lhc/test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts:161-190 verifies stored text and explicitly expects `notify` not to be called; it does not prove a headless-mode report reaches an output channel.

verified: AC-5.1 / TC-5.1: validation iterates all `FORM_KINDS` and runs from `session_start` before capture hooks are used.
AC-5.2 partial: unreachable reports include kind, provider/model, reason, and fix; interactive `ctx.ui.notify` path exists.
AC-5.3 / TC-5.3: focused test now captures, drains derivations, and verifies affected-lane failed forms through `inspect.health`.
AC-5.5 / TC-5.5: complete known-kind overrides take effect on next load.
TC-5.6 partial: incomplete known-kind assignments, unknown prompt names, explicit placeholders, and unknown config keys fail loudly.
unverified: AC-5.4 / TC-5.4: shipped defaults are real production PI registry lanes that let derivations function without operator config.
AC-5.2 / TC-5.2: unreachable-lane report is emitted through a headless output/log channel, not only stored in health.

gatesRun.command: pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec vitest run test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts test/inference/assignments.test.ts

productionPathFindings: Production default assignments now use `deterministic/default`, but the production call path still routes through PI `modelRegistry.find`; no real deterministic provider is wired for the extension runtime.
Headless startup-validation reporting still mutates health only; no emitted headless output/log channel is present.
additionalObservations: The previous gate blocker is closed; both configured gates passed.
The prior TC-5.3 coverage gap is closed by the new capture/drain/inspect health test.
